effects.text: Each of the two creatures always knows the other's general direction while within 1 mile on the same plane.

system.description:
FOLKWARDEN INSIGHT UTILITY
Folkwarden Specialist Spell
Cast 1 minute (material, somatic)
Range touch
Targets 2 willing creatures
Duration 8 hours

You tie, loop or symbolically divide a length of red thread between two creatures, creating a faint sympathetic connection.
While the creatures remain within 1 mile of one another and upon the same plane, each always knows the general direction of the other.
Red Thread does not reveal exact distance, location, physical condition or a route through intervening obstacles. If the creatures move beyond the spell's range, the connection becomes imperceptible until they return within range.
The physical thread need not remain intact once the spell has been cast.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the range to 10 miles.
+2 PP: Increase duration to 24 hours.
+4 PP: Increase the range to 100 miles.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
